# mtncloud_user_roles (Data Source)

Lists your roles, including those made in the console. Roles you can give users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_user_roles" "all" {}

output "user_roles" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_user_roles.all.user_roles : x.id => { name = x.name, name = x.name } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_regex` (String) Only return roles whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.
- `role_type` (String) Only list roles whose `role_type` is this (case ignored).

### Read-Only

- `user_roles` (Attributes List) The roles, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_roles))

<a id="nestedatt--user_roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user_roles`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `id` (Number) ID of the role.
- `multitenant` (Boolean) Whether it is shared with sub-tenants.
- `name` (String) Name of the role.
- `role_type` (String) `user` or `account`.
